title: Update SettingsView with folder picker row
description: Modify CookbookApp/Settings/SettingsView.swift. Replace the disabled Text('Not configured') row in the 'Recipes folder' section with two conditional states driven by RecipesFolderStore: (a) no folder — an enabled Button('Choose folder…') that presents RecipesFolderPicker; (b) folder configured — a row displaying folderName on the leading side and a trailing Button('Change…') that also presents RecipesFolderPicker. Cancellation leaves prior state unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: SettingsView.swift no longer has a disabled 'Not configured' Text row
When RecipesFolderStore.folderURL is nil: enabled 'Choose folder…' Button is shown
When RecipesFolderStore.folderURL is non-nil: row shows folderName leading and 'Change…' button trailing
RecipesFolderStore is accessed via environment or injected parameter — not re-instantiated
